summary: Customer manufactures tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients. They currently use laboratory checks after the material has moved through the press, so results are delayed. They want to assess whether a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes, and want a first pilot comparing reasonable measurement options before committing to production equipment.
